title: Finite morphisms preserve constructibility
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a finite
morphism with $S$ of finite type over $k$, and let $F$ be a
constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf on $X_{{\mathrm{et}}}$ (the ring $\Lambda$ of
[sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]). Then the higher direct
images $R^qf_*F$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] are
constructible on
$S_{{\mathrm{et}}}$ for every $q\geq0$, and $R^qf_*F=0$ for $q>0$:
the vanishing bound $2\cdot0$ of the zero relative dimension.

proof.text: Apply [lem-fin-finite-morphism] to the given finite morphism $f:X\to S$ and constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf $F$. Its base hypothesis is exactly that $S$ is of finite type over $k$. Its coefficient convention is the same finite commutative ring $\Lambda$ annihilated by the fixed positive integer $N$, with $N$ invertible on the schemes; thus its $f_*$ and $R^qf_*$ are those of the constant-ring module category in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], not a change of coefficient category. The cited statement gives that $f_*F$ is constructible and that $R^qf_*F=0$ for every $q>0$. No exactness assertion beyond these two clauses is taken from this citation.

source.place: Proof, first sentence: apply lem-fin-finite-morphism; underlying literature: Stacks 095R (lemma-finite-pushforward-constructible) and 03QP (proposition-finite-higher-direct-image-zero), as resolved in the cited node

proof.text: For degree zero use the module-sheaf injective-resolution computation of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Choose $0\to F\to I^0\xrightarrow{d^0}I^1\to\cdots$, with the resolution complex zero in negative degrees. Clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact] sends its initial exact sequence to $0\to f_*F\to f_*I^0\xrightarrow{f_*d^0}f_*I^1$. Consequently $R^0f_*F=\mathcal H^0(f_*I^\bullet)=\ker(f_*d^0)\cong f_*F$, since the preceding term is zero. Thus $R^0f_*F$ has the constructibility witness obtained in step 1, composed with this module-sheaf isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 05TD, lemma-left-exact-higher-derived, proof of (3): compute H^0 from the initial left exact sequence; the computation is written out here

proof.text: For $q>0$, step 1 identifies $R^qf_*F$ with the zero module sheaf. Take the finite constructible locally closed partition and the etale trivializations witnessing constructibility of $f_*F$ in step 1, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. On each of these same trivializations, the zero sheaf is the constant sheaf with value the zero $\Lambda$-module, whose underlying set has one element. Thus the same partition witnesses constructibility of $R^qf_*F$: restrictions of its isomorphism to zero supply the required constant finite-module trivializations. If $S$ is empty the empty partition works. Together with step 2 this gives constructibility for all $q\geq0$ and vanishing for $q>2\cdot0=0$.
